passage: Trained as a geologist at a time when women were often barred from the research vessels that gathered ocean-floor soundings, ____ from data collected by her male colleagues at sea, revealing a continuous rift valley running down the middle of the Atlantic.
question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.text: the hand-drawn maps of the ocean floor produced by Marie Tharp were assembled
Marie Tharp assembled her hand-drawn maps of the ocean floor
Marie Tharp's hand-drawn maps of the ocean floor were assembled
the ocean floor was mapped by Marie Tharp in hand-drawn form

explanation: The correct answer is B. The opening modifier, "Trained as a geologist ... barred from the research vessels," describes a person, so the subject that follows must be the person it describes—Marie Tharp. Only B makes "Marie Tharp" that subject. A and C put "maps" in the subject position, so the sentence absurdly says the maps were trained as a geologist. D makes "the ocean floor" the subject, with the same dangling-modifier problem.
